about_the_game:
Welcome to the Food Industry demo!

In this demo, you can play part of the first chapter, which serves as a tutorial.

Most of the features planned up to this point are implemented.

You can save your game.

There are two languages ​​available: English and French.

You can adjust some settings (resolution, quality), but these still need to be improved.

You will be able to discover a key part of the game: agriculture (fields, livestock), industry and production lines, and the sale of goods.

Some weather is available.

You can progress up to cycle 3, but you cannot play it.

You can continue playing cycle 2.

If you encounter any bugs, you can visit the Food Industry Discord.

You are evolving in a world where the climate has changed over decades of overproduction. The pollution of an ever more intensive industry has accelerated the arrival of storms that have spread across the world, devastating everything in their path.

Your only solution is to flee, to rebuild everything. Will you then make the same choices as before? Will you be able to survive in the face of increasingly intense storms?

In Food Industry, you are in charge of developing a prosperous city where survival depends on food production. You must juggle the construction of infrastructure, resource management and the well-being of citizens while facing environmental and economic challenges.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Please note! Not all of the features below are necessarily in the demo, since you can only play half of the first chapter, but they are implemented in the full game.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Key Features

✓ Agriculture: sowing and harvesting fields of grains, fruits and vegetables, and raising farm animals for its food resources.

✓ Construction and Management: Create and grow your city by balancing the needs of your citizens while overcoming the challenges of food production.

✓ Dynamic Economy: Manage your economy by establishing markets, efficiently supplying them with a wide variety of goods, while responding to the changing needs of the population. ✓ Detailed industry: build production lines machine by machine. Repair, improve, and find new line plans. Transform and assemble resources from agriculture to create new products.

✓ Interactive environment: face climatic events that affect your agriculture, your industry and the inhabitants of your city, and thus test your management skills. Collect oil, water and generate electricity via power stations or wind turbines.

✓ Immersive graphics: immerse yourself in a rich visual universe with detailed and colorful graphics. A captivating sound design where the atmosphere of storms contrasts with that of a return to calm.

Miscellaneous buildings

✓ Research and development: the main tree that allows you to evolve through the ages. New constructions, technologies and various improvements.

✓ Job Center: Automates most tasks as the city grows, and provides some bonuses or improvements. ✓ Design office: discover new automated line plans, then improve them.

✓ Protection Factory: Make protection tools to help the population cope with storms.

Weather effects

✓ Weather: As you progress, you will have to challenge unpredictable weather conditions and even devastating storms. You will have to act differently depending on the weather in different sectors of activity.

✓ Pollution: a pollution system will increase the frequency of storms and their duration.

“Food Industry” is designed for people who love construction, strategy and management games, and who want to take on challenges while giving free rein to their creativity.

An ideal city-builder for both professionals and newcomers to the genre, since everyone will be able to evolve at their own pace.

As the game is in development, new gameplay and future descriptions will be provided later.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 32-bit Windows 10/11
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz Dual Core CPU
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 660, Radeon R7 370 or equivalent with 2 GB of video RAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10/11
  • Processor: 3.2 GHz Quad Core Processor
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce 960, Radeon RX 570 or equivalent with 4GB of video RAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible

short_description: Build and expand in agriculture, industry and commerce. Evolve in the food industry sector, and weather the storms by helping your people build the new world.
